query: INSERT INTO workers(id, name, version, remote_addr, telemetry_json) VALUES(?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5) ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET last_seen=datetime('now'), version=COALESCE(excluded.version, workers.version), remote_addr=COALESCE(excluded.remote_addr, workers.remote_addr), telemetry_json=COALESCE(excluded.telemetry_json, workers.telemetry_json) RETURNING id AS "id!: Uuid", name, last_seen AS "last_seen: DateTime<Utc>", version, remote_addr, telemetry_json, max_concurrency AS "max_concurrency: i32", schedule_json
